issues.description: validate_conda accepts impostors via loose substring match on --version output
issues.detail: The check scans for 'conda'/'mamba'/'micromamba' as substrings in lowercased --version output, so any binary whose version string contains those tokens (e.g. anaconda-uninstall, conda-build) passes. Tighten the postcondition: match the leading token of the version string or check the basename.

issues.description: validate_conda returns True for empty string, conflating 'unset' with 'valid'
issues.detail: Returning True for '' is a false positive that breaks the function's name and contract. Callers expecting 'True implies usable executable' get lied to. Either split the contract (is_empty vs is_valid) or return False and let the UI layer decide that empty means unset.

issues.description: File picker filter '*.exe' is hardcoded and breaks Linux/macOS users
issues.detail: On Linux/macOS the conda/mamba/micromamba binaries have no .exe extension, so the file dialog appears empty by default. The Windows assumption leaks through a cross-platform abstraction. Platform-gate the filter or fall back to 'All files'.

issues.description: kernelspec uses persisted conda_path without re-validation
issues.detail: When custom_conda is on, kernelspec reads conda_path and uses it directly; only a falsy value triggers an error. A stale or broken path persisted earlier will be passed downstream silently. Re-check on use and surface a precise error pointing at the preference.

issues.description: run_program subprocess is never waited on or closed, leaking file descriptors per validation
issues.detail: communicate() captures stdout but the Popen object is discarded without checking returncode or closing pipes. With live validation on every keystroke in the path field, descriptors leak across a session. Bind the process, check returncode, and let it close cleanly.

issues.description: setFocus() added to shared create_browsefile helper changes behavior for every other caller
issues.detail: create_browsefile is shared infrastructure used across preference pages. Adding edit.setFocus() after select_file changes focus behavior site-wide, not just for the conda case. Move the focus call to the specific caller that needs it.

synthesis.summary: The PR adds a user-configurable conda executable override with reasonable scope, but ships a sloppy validator: substring-based identity check that admits impostors, and an empty-string-equals-valid lie. A hardcoded '*.exe' file filter breaks Linux and macOS users by leaking a Windows assumption through a cross-platform abstraction. The kernelspec consumer trusts the persisted path without re-validation, and a shared widget helper grew a setFocus side effect that affects every caller. Tighten validate_conda, platform-gate the filter, re-validate on use, and move the focus call to the caller.
